entities.label: Highwater Brook
entities.text: Highwater Brook. It ran three times this wide the night of the flood.

entities.label: Home Farm
entities.text: Home Farm. Your family's fields. The cottage stayed dry the night of the flood.

entities.label: Old Pass
entities.text: Old Pass. CLOSED by order of the council. The rockslide is still moving.

entities.label: Ridge Trail
entities.text: Ridge Trail. Follow the lanterns up to the Summit Lookout.

entities.label: Market Lane
entities.text: Market Square. Seeds to the west, bread to the south, the council up the row to the north. A coin in the well brings luck.

entities.label: Bread Lane
entities.text: Bread Lane. From the bakery to the commons. Mara bakes before dawn. Follow your nose.

entities.label: Council Row
entities.text: Council Row. Up the hill to the petition boards and the town bell. Petitions are heard daily.

entities.label: Clinic
entities.text: Valley Clinic. Six beds. Open every day since the flood.

entities.label: Floodgate
entities.text: The old floodgate. Opened once, the night of the flood. Nobody has oiled the wheel since.

entities.label: Lost Cottages
entities.text: Three homes stood on this bank before the flood. Their plots were sold afterward.

entities.label: Commons
entities.text: Village Commons. The great oak is older than the village.

entities.label: Willow Pond
entities.text: Willow Pond. The old waterline. The ducks are fond of bread.

entities.label: Clover Meadow
entities.text: Clover Meadow. Valley Suppers are held here. Fireflies gather on summer nights.

entities.label: Orchard
entities.text: Apple Orchard. The fruit ripens in fall. Other trees drop things too, if shaken.

entities.label: Reedmere Walk
entities.text: Reedmere Walk. East to Clover Lake and Reedmere pond.

entities.label: Hilltop Trail
entities.text: Hilltop Trail. Around the orchard and back down to the main street.
